address: GF, Shangri-La Plaza, Shaw Boulevard, Ortigas Centre, Mandaluyong - Metro Manila, The Philippines
bio: On the first floor of Shangri-La Plaza, Juniper combines soft grey hues and a sleek semi-open kitchen with a relaxed, modern feel. The menu blends global influences – charcuterie, pasta, roast chicken – and leans into Asian flavours at lunchtime. The UK-and Philippines-trained chef favours creativity over rigid styles. True to its name, Juniper has an impressive gin selection, with guests invited to choose their tonic for a refreshing start to the meal.
